What this change does, and why, in two plain sentences.

How the negative case is checked (the test that fails without this change):

- [ ] One topic only
- [ ] A negative test is added
- [ ] `uv run verify` passes (and the web checks, if `web/` changed)
- [ ] No real personal data, only made-up data
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or local tool settings
